title: GTA6 and Scrapped Liberty City DLC Revealed in 200GB GTA5 Source Code Leak
description: A massive 200GB GTA5 source code leak suggests Rockstar scrapped a Liberty City DLC and includes very early GTA6 files (unconfirmed rumor).
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Massive 200GB Leak Shakes the Community

According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, a massive leak involving nearly 200GB of source code related to *Grand Theft Auto V* has surfaced online. This unprecedented leak offers an unexpected look behind the scenes at Rockstar Games, suggesting that the developer once planned and ultimately scrapped a massive Liberty City expansion, alongside revealing very early files tied to the highly anticipated *GTA6*.

## Uncovering Scrapped Content and Early GTA6 Files

As details emerged from the massive data dump, data miners and community analysts began examining the contents. The files reportedly indicate that Rockstar had active development plans for a Liberty City DLC within the *GTA5* ecosystem before shelving the project entirely. Liberty City, a fan-favorite setting from previous franchise entries, would have dramatically expanded the scope of the game had it seen the light of day.

In addition to the canceled expansion material, the leak allegedly contains very early work files associated with *GTA6*. Given the extremely early nature of these files, they likely represent initial conceptual groundwork and early testing phases rather than polished game features.

## Official Silence from Rockstar Games

Rockstar Games has not issued an official statement regarding the 200GB source code leak. Code leaks of this magnitude present significant security and developmental challenges for major studios, often disrupting internal workflows. Despite the unverified nature of the material, the gaming community continues to scrutinize every piece of information surrounding the franchise's history and future.

## Editor's Take

This 200GB leak provides a fascinating, albeit unauthorized, look into Rockstar's development history. The hint of a canceled Liberty City DLC highlights the shifting priorities of the studio during *GTA5*'s lifecycle, while the early *GTA6* references underscore just how long the next chapter has been in gestation. As this information comes from a leak, it should be viewed with caution as an unconfirmed rumor rather than a definitive roadmap.
